ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.2 Playtest discovers and patches the actual PathFinder.FindPath overloads present at runtime instead of relying on a guessed signature. It logs matched PathFinder and JobGiver targets, adds worker queue/utilization telemetry, and isolates dispatcher patch failure from the rest of the runtime. Path/Job state mutation, ReservationManager and whole Pawn ticking remain on the main thread until worker-side snapshot engines are validated.
